title: How should Aldwin think?
lede: Aldwin needs a model before it can start. Keys are checked before they are saved, and are never shown again.

messages.notStarted: Your model is set up, but Aldwin did not start. Check the terminal running `aldwin web`.
messages.noModels: No models came back from that provider. Check the account, then try again.
messages.noLocalModels: No models found. Start Ollama or LM Studio with a model, then look again.
messages.stillNoKey: That model still has no working key. Add one, then try again.
